note: Small William A. Switzer PP campground of open sites for RVs and tents, 19 km north of Hwy 16 on Hwy 40 then a few km SE on a gravel access road, just north of Graveyard Lake campground; Graveyard Lake and Cache Lake are a short walk away on interpretive trails. Firewood is sold at the Switzer Park Visitor Centre and the Gregg Lake booth; sani-dump at Gregg Lake (fee). --Claude
